entry.title: New: RES25-129 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL AND RELATED EXPENSES, VALUED AT $2253.46, TO THE CITY FROM THE AMERICAN ASSOCIATION OF MOTOR VEHICLE ADMINISTRATORS (AAMVA) FOR A REPRESENTATIVE FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF FACILITY MAINTENANCE TO ATTEND THE 2025 FEDERAL MOTOR CARRIER SAFETY ADMINISTRATION/AAMVA COMMERCIAL DRIVER LICENSE COORDINATORS/INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY MANAGERS MEETING IN ORLANDO, FLORIDA, FROM MAY 6-8, 2025.
